initial_shared_prompt:

Completely redesign ALL visual language according to the TARGET DIRECTION below: people, faces, proportions, trees, clouds, island geology, wood, rammed earth, sails, color organization, outlines and shadow shapes. Do not just filter the source, change realism level or reuse its beige CGI style.
Project: an actual THIRD-PERSON THREE-DIMENSIONAL rural shipping/exploration/village-life game in an ancient East Asian floating-island world. Solid coherent 3D geometry, perspective and player-scale navigation remain comprehensible; the artistic rendering can be nonphotoreal. Same crates, four hemp sacks, jar and a few villagers in similar places. Same cloudy void below the rim and same roughly three modest distant floating islands. No ocean under the dock. CHARACTER: same adult young East Asian male working boatman, dark hair in a small practical bun, faded indigo wrap-front hip-length work jacket, rolled sleeves, undyed hemp cropped trousers, brown cloth sash, straw sandals. He is at foreground left. Turn his head and upper torso three-quarter TOWARD THE VIEWER enough to see his FACE clearly, relaxed ordinary working stance, no hero pose. Redesign face, body shape and hair drawing IN THE TARGET STYLE, staying an adult ordinary boatman. Same clothes construction, no ornaments. Exactly three other ordinary villagers near house/quay, coherent style with protagonist.
CAMERA: same human-eye-level 35mm-like view across approach, house left, boat right, horizon in upper third. Widen just slightly versus source so entire mast and sail fit. Protagonist full-body at left with readable face. All six versions keep this arrangement.
TIME/WEATHER: same fair-weather 10AM sun from upper left, open sky and clouds, ordinary daily work. Style may reinterpret all colors, shadow shapes and cloud design, but do not use sunset, night, storm, neon or epic rim lights to make a direction more impressive.
WORLD BOUNDARIES: ancient East Asian vernacular materials and working life only. No Japanese torii or samurai costume, European medieval houses, steampunk, balloons, wings, sci-fi machinery, ornamental palace roofs, magical symbols, giant crystals, glitter or supernatural effects. Floatstone does not emit light. No extra boats or elaborate decoration. No franchise characters, logos or copied distinctive assets. Use visual principles of the named reference, not its costumes or world.
